record_title: Exact complex Plücker constants above the Hilbert exponent
provenance: Scientific sources and verification evidence are listed in RESULT.md and REVIEW.md.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The source preprint does not state a single scalar-field convention next to its sharp-constant theorem; the complex case is natural from its complex projectivization and interpolation, but a real-only intended reading would make this a complementary theorem rather than a correction. Older tensor-norm and compound-matrix literature was not exhaustively inspected, and the real sharp constant for orders without a real Hadamard matrix remains undetermined. No independent validation is asserted.
